package.name: gui
package.description: Native CAD joint and balance motion dashboard for the TAP robot (executable also named `gui`, run as `ros2 run gui gui`). Owns the one-command simulation lifecycle (Launch/Stop sim) and the simulation-only reset-standup test convenience. Package name matches the wheel_leg reference GUI's own `gui` package by request; this machine's `~/bin/ros2` wrapper sources /home/dvt/wheel_leg/install first, which also installs a `gui` package — always source this workspace's own install/setup.bash (last, or instead of that wrapper) before `ros2 run gui gui`, or it may run wheel_leg's GUI instead of this one.
